message.content: It depends on who you ask, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Though released in 2019, it dominated the 2020 awards season—winning Best Picture at the Oscars, the Palme d’Or at Cannes, and sweeping numerous other accolades. If you’re looking for a definitive “best of 2020” from a critical standpoint, “Parasite” is the one most people point to.

We can mention some top movies of 2020 like "Parasite" (though it was 2019 but got awards in 2020), "1917", "The Trial of the Chicago 7", "Soul", "Tenet", "The Invisible Man". But the question is ambiguous: best movie in 2020. We can give a subjective answer or mention critics' picks. Provide a list of top movies and maybe mention that "Parasite" won Best Picture at Oscars 2020. Or mention "The Trial of the Chicago 7" as best. Provide a short answer.
